verdict: Fail: curriculum_v2 repairs the prior coverage and duplicate-boundary defects, but one prior prerequisite problem remains and the new standalone-synthesis, system-synthesis, and version-control leaves introduce blocking mutual-confidence or generation defects.
blocking_findings: Generation/internal synthesis: c01.6 does not exercise all three children coherently. Its representative validates identifier conflicts and aggregates and orders readings, covering c01.6.1 and c01.6.2, but merely returning a “compact textual summary” does not exercise c01.6.3’s defining string-structure, minimality, canonicalization, or escaping operations. The probe also leaves conflict rules, label normalization, and the output format unspecified. c01.6.3’s own representative similarly refers to “supplied escaping rules” without supplying them, so it is not an instantiable transformation contract.

The prior blockers concerning standalone function synthesis, build and dependency management, general version-control operations, duplicate homes for c01-d15, and the missing home for c01-d09 are repaired by c01.6, c01.7, c01.8, c01.5.2, and c01.2.4 respectively. The former c01 and c01.2.3 omnibus representatives were also replaced by coherent scenarios. The remaining blocking defects are those identified under mutual confidence and continuity.
mutual_confidence_findings: c01.6.2 fails mutual confidence under the same supplied-specification regime. Counterexample pair: eval-04 requires membership-based list intersection and duplicate/order handling, whereas eval-02 requires arithmetic-mean and mean-absolute-deviation computation; eval-05 instead requires derived-key matrix-row sorting. Mastery of any one does not predict most of the others because selection, statistical aggregation, and ordering are distinct central operations. Split these operation families or narrow the outcome.

c01.6.3 fails mutual confidence. Counterexample pair: eval-03 requires finding the longest palindromic suffix and appending a reversed prefix, while the c01.6.3 representative requires reversible run-length encoding with escaping and representation minimization. These require different algorithms and correctness invariants despite both returning strings.

c01.3.4 remains a composite catch-all. Counterexample pair from c01-d16 and the c01.3.4 representative: implementing transactional SQLite migrations with rollback does not predict implementing depth-bounded filesystem traversal, deterministic path aggregation, or executable-bit changes. Module separation is shared, but the distinct database, traversal, and permission operations dominate correctness; concatenating them behind an orchestration module does not create transfer.

c01.8 fails mutual confidence. A history-inspection task that selectively reverts or cherry-picks a faulty commit and the c01.8 representative’s semantic merge/rebase conflict resolution require distinct central operations; mastery of basic branch and commit construction predicts neither. Split basic history construction, conflict integration, and selective history repair.

The prior c01.2.1.1, c01.3.1.1, c01.2.3, c01.3, and c01.5 mutual-confidence defects are repaired by separating predicate, evaluation, ordering, API-restoration, code-generation, lifecycle-event, application-staging, feature, dependency, and version-control capabilities. Other leaves have a coherent central operation, but only c01.6.1, c01.6.2, and c01.6.3 have direct held-out evaluation evidence; lack of held-out evidence for the remaining leaves is insufficient evidence, not confirmation of mutual confidence.
continuity_findings: Edge c01.1 -> c01.3.3 remains invalid. The dependent representative starts with an asynchronous lease client and asks for acquisition, renewal, contention, loss, callbacks, and shutdown; it never uses c01.1’s full outcome of repository tracing plus focused and public-workflow test construction. Supplying the investigated client path and behavioral tests leaves the asynchronous coordination task intact, making this pipeline ordering. The entry also introduces awaitable adaptation and cancellation semantics rather than one operation already modeled by c01.1.

Edge c01.6.2 -> c01.3.4 is pipeline ordering rather than capability dependence. The entry first reimplements normalization, filtering, aggregation, and ordering and then places those completed functions behind a module boundary. A learner given those functions can still perform the defining c01.3.4 work—dependency-direction design, module integration, transactional/filesystem coordination, and orchestration—without mastering c01.6.2.

All 27 v2 prerequisite edges were checked. The other 25 have representative and entry probes that explicitly use the full prerequisite and add a bounded operation: the eight c01.1.1/c01.1.2.1 edges into c01.2.1.1–c01.2.1.4; both such edges into c01.2.2.1; c01.1 into c01.2.4, c01.2.2, c01.2.2.2, c01.2.2.3, c01.2.3.1, c01.3.1.1, c01.3.1.2, c01.3.2, c01.3.3.1, c01.4, c01.4.1, c01.4.2, c01.5.1, and c01.5.2; and c01.3.3.1 -> c01.3.3.2.
other_findings: Coverage ledger: all six guideposts have primary homes—C01.1 in c01.6 and the repository feature leaves, C01.2 in the c01.2.* repair leaves, C01.3 in c01.4, C01.4 in c01.1.2, C01.6 in c01.7, and C01.7 in c01.8. All 16 discovery tasks have distinct plausible primary leaves: c01-d01 through c01-d16 map respectively to c01.3.3.2, c01.2.1.1, c01.2.1.3, c01.5.1, c01.3.1.2, c01.2.3.1, c01.2.1.4, c01.2.2.1, c01.2.4, c01.2.2.2, c01.2.1.2, c01.3.2, c01.2.2.3, c01.3.1.1, c01.5.2, and c01.3.4.

Evaluation ledger: six applicable held-out synthesis probes have plausible primary homes—eval-01 and eval-06 in c01.6.1, eval-02, eval-04, and eval-05 in c01.6.2, and eval-03 in c01.6.3. Eval-08 is properly excluded because it tests hardware instruction scheduling without software implementation. There is no direct held-out evidence for repository investigation, testing, repair, feature extension, refactoring, optional dependencies, packaging, or version-control operations; their evaluation coverage remains insufficient.

Internal-node synthesis was checked for c01, c01.6, c01.1, c01.1.2, c01.2.2, c01.3.3, c01.4, and c01.7. Apart from c01.6, their representatives use one natural artifact or workflow across children: an optional parser plugin, one manifest defect, one stateful import command, one resource-reference importer, one lease client and leader, one configuration subsystem, and one library release respectively.

All 36 sections contain exactly one entry and one representative instruction. The annotations still provide semantic keys but no task-to-section retrieval results, similarities, or neighbor stability, so mapping quality cannot be independently evaluated.
